domestic_evidence: No domestic supply evidence retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India sales splits were not obtained: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and thecompanycheck.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403. claas.in/en/company/about-us returned an empty body. Nothing to quote; field left null rather than estimated.
note: Registry/catalogue data excluded per scope. What IS documented is inbound supply only: 3260 import records, 6 trading partners, 12 port lanes, latest cargo 2026-02-24, top ports ICD CONCOR DHANDARI KALAN LUDHIANA INLDH6 (245), Hamburg (237), DUESSELDORF (81), DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4 (59). This is the Indian arm of the German CLAAS group importing combine-harvester spares from CLAAS SERVICE AND PARTS GMBH (Harsewinkel/Hamm, Germany) and CLAAS SAULGAU GMBH, plus CLAAS AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY SHANDONG CO LIMITED (Gaomi, China) — i.e. an importer/distributor role, not a demonstrated exporter. Declared HS 848291 (balls/rollers for bearings) does not match any observed line: actual codes on record are 84818090, 85365090, 84339000, 84836090, 85366990 — agricultural machinery parts. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the code should be corrected to the factual 84339000 (parts of harvesting/threshing machinery) and the verdict kept as accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is also inconsistent with the observed agricultural-machinery parts trade and should be corrected to agricultural machinery. Export status is none_found on the evidence available, not a positive finding of no exports: the free tier of every export database was blocked (403) and the search engine was down, so outbound shipments may exist but are unverified. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached. No CIN/PAN asserted.
